D-grouse-atv-0048.name: By Rendell Creek
D-grouse-atv-0048.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
D-grouse-atv-0048.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Rendell Creek Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
9 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

private land only, with the landowner's permission

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 204 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.71257, -118.69273, where the truck road ends (Rendell Creek Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 320 m to the start. Ride: the Rendell 8000 stretch, 6.7 km one way. About 133 min one way at 3 km/h.

Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
